buildNotes:
This build includes the following changes:
- Loading spinners on delete and slow actions (schools, documents, folders, professor emails, collaboration, Google Docs)
- Security hardening: HTML sanitization, guest link cookies and 14-day default expiry, tighter CSRF, opt-in superadmin bootstrap and Google account linking (see docs/SECURITY.md)
- Cloudflare Workers: smaller deploy bundle (CF_BUILD pipeline, Prisma client-only engine, heavy doc extractors stubbed on Workers)
- Admin analytics, collaboration review sessions, Google Docs sync, and onboarding fixes from 1.5.0 remain in place
